$comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Shaped like a response from the UCDP API at https://ucdpapi.pcr.uu.se/api/gedevents/<version>, so the parser can be exercised offline. The events are invented and no real incident is described; country and place names are real only so the country-code lookup is exercised. Field names and the TotalCount/TotalPages/Result envelope follow UCDP's published API documentation. The where_prec values are chosen to cover every branch of the precision mapping, and their meanings are the GED codebook's: 1 exact, 2 within ~25 km of a coded known point, 4 first-order administrative division centroid, 6 country only.

Result.source_article: An invented state-based clash recorded for fixture purposes.
A fictional attack on civilians used to exercise the severity bands.
A fictional non-state clash placed only to a province, so it must not be drawn as a fix.
A fictional record known only to a country, which must say so rather than imply a position.
A record with no identifier at all, which the parser must skip rather than guess at.
